description: Cards with a picture on top and a read link, or with a muted glyph panel on top like an index of categories, in three or four columns.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Features as cards under a centered heading. Axes: item (picture: a picture on top, then the title, the text
  and a read link; panel: a muted panel with a large glyph on top, then the title and the text), cols (3, 4),
  tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

export type FeatureShowcaseProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  features: Feature[];
  empty?: string;
  more: string;
  item?: "picture" | "panel";
  cols?: "3" | "4";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Card from "../compose/Card.vue";
import CardContent from "../compose/CardContent.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import MenuEntry from "../components/menu-entry.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  features,
  empty = "",
  more,
  item = "picture",
  cols = "3",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<FeatureShowcaseProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :tone="tone" align="center" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((features?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="layout-grid" :title="empty" />
    <Box v-else
      :class="
        (cols as string) === '4' ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 text-start sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4'
        : 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 text-start sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3'
      "
    >
      <Card
        v-for="f in features"
        :key="f.id"
        variant="default"
        class="h-full gap-4 overflow-hidden"
        data-testid="showcase-card"
      >
        <MediaFrame v-if="((item as string) === 'picture')" :alt="f.title" />
        <Box v-else
          class="flex aspect-video items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted text-foreground"
          data-testid="showcase-panel"
        >
          <LucideIcon :name="f.icon" :size="32" />
        </Box>
        <CardContent class="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
          <Title :as="3" size="base" weight="semibold">
            {{ f.title }}
          </Title>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ f.text }}
          </Text>
          <MenuEntry
            v-if="((item as string) === 'picture')"
            :href="f.href"
            class="mt-auto gap-2 pt-2 text-sm font-medium"
            size="sm"
            testid="read"
          >
            {{ more }}
            <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" :size="16" />
          </MenuEntry>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
